summary: Verified WebP compression fix for AI-generated images and media uploads. All 3 backend tests passed: /api/ai/illustrate, /api/ai/image, and /api/media now return .webp URLs with Content-Type image/webp, valid decodable images at expected dimensions (1536x1024 for AI, capped at 1600px width for uploads), all well under 1 MB.
seed_data_creation: None. Test upload creates a transient 2000x1200 PNG in-memory.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_webp_compression.py covers the WebP fix. Verified: (1) AI illustrate returns .webp URL, image/webp CT, 1536x1024, <1MB; (2) AI image endpoint same behavior; (3) Media upload converts PNG to WebP with width<=1600, returns content_type image/webp, and WebP is smaller than uploaded PNG. All 3 pass in ~108s (AI generation dominates). Cache-Control override by ingress noted in review request — not tested/flagged.
rca of the issue: N/A — verifying an already-applied fix. Root cause per main agent: gpt-image-1 returns ~3MB PNGs stored uncompressed. Fix: compress_image() in storage.py converts to WebP q=82, max width 1600; ai.py _gen_and_store() applies compression before storing. Verified working — served images are valid WebP under 1MB.
